test.prompt: Use only the configured Composio Gmail tools. Confirm the authenticated Gmail profile exactly matches the configured isolated test inbox {{source}}. Send exactly one plain-text email from that account to the same address with subject '[Kamdar connection test {{run_id}}] Gmail' and a body containing the same run ID. Fetch that message after sending and report the authenticated address, message ID, thread ID, exact subject, recipient, and read-back result. Do not send to any other address and do not modify any existing message.
test.expected_output: The configured Gmail account is confirmed, one self-addressed setup-test email is sent, and the same message is fetched successfully.
assertions: The authenticated Gmail profile exactly matches the configured isolated test inbox.
Exactly one email is sent and its only recipient is that same inbox.
The response reports the sent message ID and thread ID.
The sent message is fetched and its subject and run ID exactly match the request.
